summary: The encoder's input x is used as queries, keys and values. Each of h = 8 heads projects it down to 64 dimensions and runs scaled dot-product attention. The 8 head outputs are concatenated back to 512 and mixed by W^O; this split is exactly what the paper's equations define.

blocks.label: Input x
blocks.description: In encoder self-attention, the previous layer's output serves as queries, keys and values all at once.
blocks.source_quote: In a self-attention layer all of the keys, values and queries come from the same place, in this case, the output of the previous layer in the encoder.

blocks.label: Query projection
blocks.description: A learned linear map turns each 512-dim position into a 64-dim query for this head.
blocks.source_quote: Instead of performing a single attention function with d model -dimensional keys, values and queries, we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values h times with different, learned linear projections to d k , d k and d v dimensions, respectively.

blocks.label: Key projection
blocks.description: A separate learned linear map produces this head's 64-dim keys.
blocks.source_quote: In this work we employ h = 8 parallel attention layers, or heads.

blocks.label: Value projection
blocks.description: A third learned linear map produces this head's 64-dim values, the content that will be mixed.
blocks.source_quote: For each of these we use d k = d v = d model /h = 64 .

blocks.label: Scaled dot product
blocks.description: Scores every query against every key, giving an n×n compatibility table, scaled by 1/8 so the softmax does not saturate.
blocks.source_quote: To counteract this effect, we scale the dot products by 1 √ d k .

blocks.label: Softmax
blocks.description: Normalizes each row of scores into weights that sum to 1, so each position decides how much to look at every other position.
blocks.source_quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by √ d k , and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.

blocks.label: Weighted sum of values
blocks.description: Each position's output is the attention-weighted average of all value vectors.

blocks.label: Concat heads
blocks.description: Stacks the 8 head outputs side by side, restoring a 512-dim vector per position.
blocks.source_quote: These are concatenated and once again projected, resulting in the final values, as depicted in Figure 2.

blocks.label: Output projection
blocks.description: A learned linear map mixes information across the heads' subspaces.
blocks.source_quote: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

blocks.label: Output
blocks.description: A context-mixed representation per position, passed to the Add & Norm sub-layer (encoder_add_norm_1).
blocks.source_quote: Each position in the encoder can attend to all positions in the previous layer of the encoder.
